title: When Something Stops Working: Modes From Full Speed to a Safe Stop, a Second Fault That Costs More, and Coming Back Up One Step at a Time

artifact.note: degraded modes for a ground vehicle: four modes (full, reduced, creep, safe stop) each with a speed cap; a rule that gives the mode a set of health flags and the uncertainty of the position require (a lost scanner is a stop, a lost gyro a creep, a lost GNSS, link or wheel sensor a reduced mode, any two of the last four a creep, and a position sigma past its steps worse again); a manager that goes down at once and comes back up one step at a time after a dwell in which the requirement stayed better; and the distance a vehicle can go on dead reckoning before the uncertainty puts it in the next mode
